look_here_first: FLATTEN A MATURE LEAF in view: leaf edge often WAVY/crisped and blade narrow TRIANGULAR, with heart-shaped base. Then inspect an OPEN FLOWER face: large (~20 mm across), brownish/orange to green, 5 broad spreading lobes; white-pink fleshy corona inside. Unlike climbing milkweed F. cynanchoides, flowers generally are larger and lack the many cream/rose-tinged little petals. Confirm flowers and fruit when leaf margins are not obviously curled.

key_traits.label: Life cycle
key_traits.text: Perennial herbaceous, twining and trailing milkvine; multiple long slender stems and white milky latex.

key_traits.label: Stems
key_traits.text: Cylindrical twining stems up to ~2 mm diameter; short DOWNWARD-CURVED simple hairs (0.1–0.2 mm) plus inconspicuous glandular hairs; no tendrils.

key_traits.label: Leaves
key_traits.text: Opposite, decussate, simple, short-petiolate, typically triangular to narrowly triangular blades (about 25–75 mm long), cordate at base; often wavy/crispate edges but sometimes almost flat. Many upper sun leaves are narrower; leaf pairs may be unequal in size.

key_traits.label: Inflorescence
key_traits.text: Axillary umbel-like cymes, often roughly hemispheric clusters of up to ~9 comparatively large flowers on a short hairy peduncle.

key_traits.label: Flowers
key_traits.text: Corolla five-lobed, rotate, roughly 20 mm across, lobes about 10 mm long; upper-facing petals orange to brown or greenish, short-ciliate along margins; typically glabrous inside. Corolla color changes with age, so use leaf edge and larger flowers together.

key_traits.label: Corona
key_traits.text: Five fleshy thumb-like segments, often pink/rose and white, visibly constricted around midlength (Flora of North America key). These are NOT separate petals; inspect central milkweed gynostegium and pollinia.

key_traits.label: Fruits
key_traits.text: One or two long slender follicles, often ~10–13 cm; seeds furnished with silky white hairs (coma). Pods can be more diagnostic than flower color when mature.

key_traits.label: Identification
key_traits.text: larger brown/orange-green starry corollas ~20 mm diameter

key_traits.label: Identification
key_traits.text: flower crown of pink-white thick coronas with median waist

key_traits.label: Identification
key_traits.text: short-haired axillary cymes, white milky latex
